supplements.title: Integrating Network Pharmacology and Experimental Validation to Elucidate the Role of Huaier in Attenuating Liver Fibrosis via the AKT Signalling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Huaier, a natural compound, reduces liver fibrosis by blocking the AKT protein pathway that activates scar-forming cells.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid-induced apoptosis in SCC-9 cells revealed by TMT proteomics and network pharmacology.
supplements.summary: Licorice compound 18β-GRA kills tongue cancer cells by triggering apoptosis, cell cycle arrest, and oxidative stress through PI3K/AKT pathway inhibition.

supplements.title: PLSCR1 drives chemoresistance in TNBC via METTL3/IGF2BP3-mediated mRNA stabilization and EGFR-MAPK pathway activation.
supplements.summary: PLSCR1 protein drives triple-negative breast cancer drug resistance through two pathways; blocking it with Mogroside IV-A restores chemotherapy sensitivity.

supplements.title: Impact of leucine-rich diet on placenta's proteomic and metabolomic profiles of pregnant tumor-bearing rats.
supplements.summary: A leucine-rich diet may protect placental and fetal development in pregnant rats with cancer by reducing tumor-induced molecular damage.

supplements.title: Betulinic acid alleviates the inflammatory injury of osteoblasts in osteoporosis by augmenting autophagy via the AMPK-mTOR signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Betulinic acid protects bone cells from inflammatory damage in osteoporosis by activating autophagy through the AMPK-mTOR pathway.

supplements.title: Tauroursodeoxycholic acid (TUDCA) ameliorates age-related skeletal muscle loss.
supplements.summary: TUDCA, a bile acid, restores muscle mass and function in aging mice by improving insulin sensitivity and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Human multi-tissue transcriptomics identifies galectin-1 and follistatin-like 1 as exerkines with distinct transcript-to-serum coupling after exercise.
supplements.summary: Exercise increases galectin-1 and follistatin-like 1 in the blood, with body composition determining how much enters circulation.

supplements.title: Lactucin inhibits growth and induces apoptosis in gastric cancer cells by targeting MAPK signaling.
supplements.summary: Lactucin, a natural compound from chicory, stops gastric cancer cell growth and triggers cell death by blocking a key cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Atractylenolide I Blocks Lung Metastasis of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer by Inhibiting SPP1-Mediated Extracellular Matrix Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Atractylenolide I, a plant compound, blocks triple-negative breast cancer spread to the lungs by disrupting a protein involved in metastasis.

supplements.title: Anticancer activity of Hebesu extracts in cancer cell lines.
supplements.summary: Hebesu citrus extract kills breast, liver, and lung cancer cells by triggering cell death and blocking cancer-promoting genes.

supplements.title: Ginsenosides in the management of depression: a comprehensive pharmacological review.
supplements.summary: Ginsenosides from ginseng show promise treating depression through multiple mechanisms including neurotransmitter modulation and reduced brain inflammation.

supplements.title: Improved anticancer efficacy of plant leaf extracts from homa environment: A preliminary study.
supplements.summary: Plant leaf extracts from homa-treated environments show improved cancer-fighting effectiveness compared to standard sources.

supplements.title: Interactions Between ADIPOQ rs1501299 Polymorphism, Dietary Macronutrient Composition, and Gastric Cancer Risk: Evidence from a Korean Case-Control Study.
supplements.summary: A genetic variant in the ADIPOQ gene modified how diet's macronutrient balance affected gastric cancer risk in Korean adults.

supplements.title: A BBB-permeable β3-AR probe enables redox imaging, natural inhibitors discovery, and therapeutic monitoring in glioblastoma.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a brain-penetrating probe that visualizes β3-receptors and monitors stress levels in glioblastoma, identifying baicalin as a natural drug candidate.

supplements.title: Ultraprocessed Foods and the Aging Brain: State of the Science.
supplements.summary: High ultraprocessed food consumption may harm brain aging through poor nutrition and added chemicals, though more research is needed.

off_label.title: Combination of ivermectin and metformin promotes autophagy in MCF‑7 cells by inhibiting phosphorylation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
off_label.summary: Combining ivermectin and metformin kills breast cancer cells by triggering autophagy through increased oxidative stress and pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: The role of ATP synthase subunit e (ATP5I) in mediating the metabolic and antiproliferative effects of metformin in cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin fights pancreatic cancer and osteosarcoma by targeting ATP5I protein, disrupting cancer cell energy production and blocking growth.

off_label.title: LKB1 Loss Sensitizes Lung Tumor Spheres to Mitomet-Induced Ferroptosis, and These Effects are Enhanced by mTOR Inhibition.
off_label.summary: LKB1-mutant lung cancer stem cells die when treated with mitomet and mTOR inhibitors through ferroptosis, a new therapeutic approach.

off_label.title: Inhibition of ceramide synthesis ameliorates body wasting in a cancer cachexia model.
off_label.summary: Blocking ceramide production in the liver reduces muscle wasting in cancer cachexia, offering a potential new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Repurposing Resmetirom to Suppress MASLD/MASH-HCC in the Dysmetabolic Era.
off_label.summary: Resmetirom, a drug approved for fatty liver disease, may help prevent or treat liver cancer by reducing inflammation and improving metabolic health.

off_label.title: Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Inhibitors and Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B and Hypertension: A Nationwide Dose-Response Cohort Study.
off_label.summary: Blood pressure drugs called ACE inhibitors may lower liver cancer risk in hepatitis B patients with hypertension.

off_label.title: Harnessing Cuproptosis for Antitumor Immunity: A Review of Current Evidence and Therapeutic Strategies.
off_label.summary: Triggering copper-driven cell death could enhance immune checkpoint inhibitor effectiveness across multiple cancer types.

off_label.title: Dose-Response Relationship of Niclosamide and Metformin Combination in ApcMin/+ Mice: An Integrated In Vivo and Pharmacokinetic Modeling Study.
off_label.summary: Combining niclosamide and metformin reduces polyps in mice with familial adenomatous polyposis, a hereditary colorectal cancer condition.

off_label.title: Disulfiram/Copper Complex Induces Cytotoxicity in Pancreatic Cancer Cells and 5-Fluorouracil-Resistant Cells through Nuclear Factor E2-Related Factor-2 Suppression and Reactive Oxygen Species Modulation.
off_label.summary: Disulfiram combined with copper kills pancreatic cancer cells, including those resistant to standard chemotherapy.

off_label.title: A subset of Histamine H4 receptor antagonists prevents B lymphocyte proliferation induced by BCR/TLR9 engagement or EBV infection.
off_label.summary: Histamine H4 receptor antagonists block EBV-infected B cell proliferation and suppress lymphoma growth in preclinical models.

off_label.title: Nine-Year Recurrence-Free Survival in Gastric Signet-Ring Cell Carcinoma: A Case Report of Laparoscopic Radical Resection Combining Long-Term Systematic Therapy and Metformin Enteric-Coated Tablets.
off_label.summary: A gastric cancer patient achieved nine-year recurrence-free survival using surgery combined with chemotherapy and metformin maintenance therapy.

off_label.title: Dopamine D2 Receptor Agonists as Modulators of VEGF-A-Driven Angiogenesis: Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Translational Opportunities.
off_label.summary: Dopamine D2 receptor agonists suppress tumor blood vessel growth by blocking VEGF-A signaling, offering a potential new cancer treatment approach.

off_label.title: Simvastatin Restores Cisplatin Sensitivity by Suppressing the Caveolin-1-Mediated PI3K/AKT Signaling Pathway in Cisplatin-Resistant Cervical Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Simvastatin restores cisplatin effectiveness in resistant cervical cancer by blocking a key resistance pathway, suggesting it could improve chemotherapy outcomes.

off_label.title: Nintedanib is a potent FLT3 inhibitor with activity against FLT3-ITD and overcomes the gatekeeper F691L resistance mutation in acute myeloid leukemia.
off_label.summary: Nintedanib, a lung disease drug, effectively treats acute myeloid leukemia by blocking FLT3 mutations, even resistant ones.

off_label.title: Toremifene in desmoid fibromatosis: Prospective phase 2 study of two dose levels.
off_label.summary: A study tested whether toremifene, an existing drug, safely and effectively treats desmoid fibromatosis at different dose levels.

biomarkers.title: An orthotopic organoid-based model to study early CD8⁺ T cell dysfunction and immunotherapy response in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a colorectal cancer model showing CD8+ T cell dysfunction and improved responses to immunotherapy treatment.

biomarkers.title: The germline landscape of pituitary adenomas: established and emerging predisposition genes.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified genetic mutations that predispose people to pituitary adenomas, enabling personalized screening and family testing strategies.

biomarkers.title: Dissecting acute neuronal responses to glioblastoma using a dual-interface human iPSC neuronal culture platform.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a lab model showing how glioblastoma tumors rapidly remodel neuronal connections through specific signaling pathways, suggesting potential drug targets.

biomarkers.title: Navigating false-positive outcomes after stool-based colorectal cancer screening tests: a scoping review.
biomarkers.summary: Stool-based colorectal cancer screening sometimes shows positive results despite negative colonoscopy, requiring clarification on appropriate follow-up management.

biomarkers.title: In their own words: a qualitative exploration of patients' perspectives of genetic counseling sessions across clinical disciplines.
biomarkers.summary: Patients value genetic counselors who listen, collaborate, provide clear information, and empower them with actionable recommendations.

biomarkers.title: A sensitive and cost-effective 'turn-on' aptasensor for carcinoembryonic antigen using Ce-UiO-66 as an ultraefficient nanoquencher.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a cost-effective fluorescent sensor using nanoparticles that sensitively detects carcinoembryonic antigen, a cancer tumor marker.

biomarkers.title: Estimation of split renal function on PET using the SSTR-targeting radioligands [18F]SiTATE, [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE and [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TOC in a theranostic setting.
biomarkers.summary: SSTR-PET scans can predict kidney function and radiation dose in neuroendocrine cancer patients receiving targeted therapy.

biomarkers.title: Massive cardiac echinococcosis.
biomarkers.summary: Cardiac echinococcosis, an extremely rare parasitic cyst disease, can cause chest pain and breathlessness, diagnosed through imaging scans.

biomarkers.title: Human Health Risk Assessment of Potentially Toxic Metals and Natural Radionuclides in Unrefined Edible Salts from Salt Mining Communities of Nasarawa State, Nigeria.
biomarkers.summary: Unrefined edible salts from Nigerian mining communities contain toxic metals like arsenic and cadmium exceeding safe limits, posing cancer and non-cancer health risks to consumers.

biomarkers.title: Study on the synergistic efficacy and mechanism of CD24 silencing combined with trastuzumab in HER2-positive breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Silencing CD24 alongside trastuzumab improves treatment effectiveness in HER2-positive breast cancer.

biomarkers.title: Carboplatin with or without nivolumab in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer: a randomized phase II trial.
biomarkers.summary: Adding nivolumab to carboplatin showed no overall survival benefit in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, but improved outcomes in PD-L1-positive patients.

biomarkers.title: A phase II peri-operative study of pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib for mucosal melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib before surgery showed modest response in mucosal melanoma, with immune cell activation predicting better outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Targeting lysine-specific demethylase 1 inhibits melanoma metastasis via the NF2-Hippo-YAP pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking LSD1 protein stops melanoma from spreading by activating a natural tumor-suppressing pathway in skin cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: Molecular Tumor Boards in Malignant Melanoma: Uncovering Challenges and Opportunities in a Bicenter Retrospective Analysis in Germany.
biomarkers.summary: Molecular tumor boards identified personalized treatments for advanced melanoma patients, significantly improving survival when recommendations were actually implemented.

biomarkers.title: Marked variation in eligibility criteria across registrational trials for relapsed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma limits applicability to clinical practice.
biomarkers.summary: Strict and varying eligibility criteria in relapsed lymphoma trials exclude most real-world patients, limiting how well trial results apply to actual clinical practice.

trials.title: Navigating false-positive outcomes after stool-based colorectal cancer screening tests: a scoping review.
trials.summary: Stool-based colorectal cancer screening sometimes shows positive results despite negative colonoscopy, requiring clarification on appropriate follow-up management.

trials.title: Estimation of split renal function on PET using the SSTR-targeting radioligands [18F]SiTATE, [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TATE and [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TOC in a theranostic setting.
trials.summary: SSTR-PET scans can predict kidney function and radiation dose in neuroendocrine cancer patients receiving targeted therapy.

trials.title: Study on the synergistic efficacy and mechanism of CD24 silencing combined with trastuzumab in HER2-positive breast cancer.
trials.summary: Silencing CD24 alongside trastuzumab improves treatment effectiveness in HER2-positive breast cancer.

trials.title: A Phase I trial of the anti-IL23 monoclonal antibody tildrakizumab, in combination with abiraterone acetate, for the treatment of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
trials.summary: A new drug combination targeting IL23 and androgen receptors shows promise in treating advanced prostate cancer resistant to standard therapy.

trials.title: Feasibility study of the Four-Session Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy-based Psychological Intervention Program for women with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer.
trials.summary: A brief four-session therapy program shows promise for reducing emotional distress in women with advanced HER2-positive breast cancer.

trials.title: Effects of activity pacing-related interventions on cancer-related fatigue and classification of behavior change techniques: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Activity pacing interventions help reduce fatigue in cancer patients by balancing activity with rest periods.

trials.title: Carboplatin with or without nivolumab in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer: a randomized phase II trial.
trials.summary: Adding nivolumab to carboplatin showed no overall survival benefit in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, but improved outcomes in PD-L1-positive patients.

trials.title: A phase II peri-operative study of pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib for mucosal melanoma.
trials.summary: Pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib before surgery showed modest response in mucosal melanoma, with immune cell activation predicting better outcomes.

trials.title: Molecular Tumor Boards in Malignant Melanoma: Uncovering Challenges and Opportunities in a Bicenter Retrospective Analysis in Germany.
trials.summary: Molecular tumor boards identified personalized treatments for advanced melanoma patients, significantly improving survival when recommendations were actually implemented.

trials.title: Marked variation in eligibility criteria across registrational trials for relapsed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma limits applicability to clinical practice.
trials.summary: Strict and varying eligibility criteria in relapsed lymphoma trials exclude most real-world patients, limiting how well trial results apply to actual clinical practice.

trials.title: Assessment of triglyceride-glucose composite indices associated mortality risk in diabetes-related heart failure.
trials.summary: A new risk score using blood sugar and triglyceride levels helps identify diabetic heart failure patients with worse survival outcomes.

trials.title: MRI in Sheep Model for Myelomeningocele Repair Using a Novel Polymer and Other Dural Patches.
trials.summary: Researchers tested three dural patches for prenatal myelomeningocele repair, using MRI to compare how well each one healed in sheep.

trials.title: Balancing Efficacy and Safety in Multiple Myeloma Patients Receiving B cell Maturation Antigen-Directed CAR T-Cell Therapy.
trials.summary: BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy effectively treats multiple myeloma but requires careful monitoring for common and rare side effects including toxicity syndromes and infections.

trials.title: Biomarker-Driven Management of Nonmetastatic GEJ Adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Molecular biomarkers could improve how doctors treat gastroesophageal junction cancer by tailoring therapy to individual tumors.

trials.title: MRI- and report-based multimodal model with SHAP-based explanation for preoperative prediction of deep stromal invasion in early-stage cervical cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an AI model using MRI scans and reports to predict how deep cervical cancer has invaded tissue before surgery.
